name: Iluvatar CoreX BI-V150 specifications (mirrorfrog, citing procurement documentation)
notes: 64 GB HBM2e and 1.2 TB/s are reported as confirmed by Chinese procurement specifications (incl. Nankai University 2025 accelerator procurement); a 32 GB variant also exists. Iluvatar publishes no datasheet for BI-V150, so this is the best available figure, not a vendor datasheet number.
